item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Harsh heating solid ghee in a dish. A thermometer is placed in the ghee. At one fixed temperature the solid ghee turns into liquid ghee.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: At the melting point, particles vibrate enough to leave fixed positions; that temperature identifies the solid-to-liquid change at atmospheric pressure.
options.B: The melting point is the temperature at which liquid ghee turns back into solid ghee while being heated.
options.C: Solid ghee melts at that temperature even if particle vibrations do not increase.
options.D: Any warm temperature counts as the melting point, not only the fixed temperature where solid becomes liquid.
